scope: Runtime arguments and generic type parameterization; option inheritance, threading, counters and report formatting remain separately audited.

mapping.feature: Inline argument expressions and shared external iterables
mapping.airbug: args accepts IntoIterator; Copy values borrowed from shared slices

mapping.feature: Non-Copy argument by reference and strings as str
mapping.airbug: Persistent owned argument storage with borrowed invocation
setup and counter expressions; typed closures or named functions for shared-slice owned parameters

mapping.feature: Generic type list, trait constraints and lifetime-dependent output
mapping.airbug: types list and preserved function bounds
types + args; multiple type parameters supported through tuple rows

mapping.feature: Criterion parameter reference and caller-selected identity
mapping.airbug: Suite closures capture parameter references and explicit case names; no Bencher source compatibility required

differences: Airbug local arguments do not require Send/Sync; threaded registration enforces its own bounds.
Registration evaluates iterables to enumerate names, while setup and workloads remain lazy.
Airbug does not implement the upstream Bencher argument signature; setup/counters and Suite closures supply the capabilities.
